name: MostasHaR15 Pivot
summary: This EA trades based on pivot point levels, automatically calculating daily, weekly, or monthly pivot support and resistance levels and executing trades when price interacts with these key levels. It identifies breakout and bounce opportunities at pivot lines, using them as dynamic support/resistance zones for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于支点(Pivot Point)水平进行交易，自动计算日、周或月支点的支撑和阻力位，并在价格与这些关键水平交互时执行交易。它识别支点线的突破和反弹机会，将其作为入场和出场的动态支撑/阻力区域。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于经典支点(Pivot Point)计算方法，通过前一日的高、低、收盘价计算出主要支点及多个支撑(S1-S3)和阻力(R1-R3)水平。入场条件主要分为两类：一是价格从支点水平反弹时顺势交易，二是价格突破支点水平时跟随突破方向入场。出场条件通常设定为止盈和止损，部分版本可能结合支点目标位作为止盈参考。仓位管理方面，EA可能采用固定手数或基于资金的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，如果缺少最大持仓限制或回撤控制，可能存在过度开仓的风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，支点水平在日内交易中具有较好的参考价值，但策略有效性依赖于市场波动性和时间框架的选择。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the classic pivot point calculation method, deriving the main pivot along with multiple support (S1-S3) and resistance (R1-R3) levels from the previous period's high, low, and close prices. Entry conditions fall into two main categories: first, trading in the direction of a bounce off a pivot level, and second, following a breakout direction when price breaks through a pivot level. Exit conditions are typically set with take-profit and stop-loss levels, with some versions potentially using pivot target levels as take-profit references. Position sizing may use fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management could pose over-exposure risk if the EA lacks maximum position limits or drawdown controls. The overall strategy logic is clear and pivot levels hold solid reference value in intraday trading, but strategy effectiveness depends heavily on market volatility and the chosen timeframe.

parameters.name: PivotTimeframe
parameters.description: 支点计算的时间框架(日/周/月)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 manages all positions

parameters.name: UseBounceStrategy
parameters.description: 是否启用反弹交易策略

parameters.name: UseBreakoutStrategy
parameters.description: 是否启用突破交易策略

pros: 支点水平是广泛使用的技术分析工具，具有良好的市场心理支撑
策略逻辑简单直观，入场和出场条件明确，易于理解和优化
支持反弹和突破两种交易模式，适应不同市场状态
pros_en: Pivot levels are widely-used technical analysis tools with strong market psychology support
Strategy logic is simple and intuitive with clear entry and exit conditions, easy to understand and optimize
Supports both bounce and breakout trading modes, adapting to different market conditions
cons: 经典支点计算方法较为简单，在剧烈波动或趋势行情中支撑阻力可能失效
缺乏高级过滤条件如趋势确认或波动性过滤，可能在震荡市中频繁止损
固定止损止盈未考虑ATR等动态波动指标，无法适应不同市场波动环境
cons_en: Classic pivot calculation is relatively simple and support/resistance levels may fail in volatile or strong trending markets
Lacks advanced filters like trend confirmation or volatility filtering, leading to frequent stop-outs in choppy markets
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit don't account for dynamic volatility indicators like ATR, unable to adapt to varying market volatility environments
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势过滤，仅在主趋势方向交易支点信号
使用ATR动态调整止损止盈，使风险管理更适应市场波动
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filtering to only trade pivot signals in the direction of the dominant trend
Use ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to make risk management more adaptive to market volatility

risk_points: 支点水平在低流动性时段可能产生虚假突破信号
如果没有持仓检查机制，可能在同一支点水平重复开仓
risk_points_en: Pivot levels may generate false breakout signals during low liquidity sessions
Without position check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions at the same pivot level
